projectDescription: Open GSD is a suite of AI-powered developer tools — including a spec-driven coding workflow engine (GSD Core), an autonomous local coding agent (GSD Pi), and a native browser automation layer (GSD Browser) — that help teams plan, implement, verify, and ship software with AI agents.
keyFeatures: Spec-driven development pipeline: Requirements → Research → Plan → Execute → Verify → Ship
Fresh-context subagent architecture prevents context rot across long coding sessions
Wave-based parallel execution of independent plans within a phase
65+ slash commands across workflow, quality, context, project, and management namespaces
15 supported AI runtimes (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, and more)
Cross-AI code review from multiple LLM providers (Gemini, Codex, OpenCode, Qwen, Ollama, etc.)
Autonomous mode: fully automated plan → implement → verify → advance loop
Local project memory in .planning/ (GSD Core) and .gsd/ (GSD Pi) with human-readable Markdown projections
Multi-provider model routing with per-phase model profiles (quality / balanced / budget)
Git worktree isolation for parallel and safe development
Extension system with bundled and community extensions
Native browser automation via CDP with versioned element refs and MCP server mode
Live authenticated viewer for human-in-the-loop browser automation sessions
Headless/CI mode for pipeable, JSON-output automation
Supply-chain protection: slopcheck gate on all AI-recommended packages
Session persistence and cross-session context handoffs
publicApiSurface: npx @opengsd/gsd-core@latest — interactive installer for GSD Core
/gsd-new-project — initialize a new project
/gsd-discuss-phase N — pre-planning discussion for a phase
/gsd-plan-phase N — research + plan + verify for a phase
/gsd-execute-phase N — execute a phase with wave-based parallelization
/gsd-verify-work N — user acceptance testing with auto-diagnosis
/gsd-ship N — create a GitHub pull request
/gsd-progress — show current position and next steps
/gsd-autonomous — run all remaining phases autonomously
/gsd-code-review N — review phase code changes
/gsd-debug [description] — systematic debugging with persistent state
/gsd-settings — interactive 6-section configuration wizard
/gsd-map-codebase — parallel codebase analysis
/gsd-review --phase N -- cross-AI peer review
npx @opengsd/gsd-pi@latest — interactive installer for GSD Pi
gsd — start interactive TUI session
gsd --web — launch browser-based web interface
gsd headless [cmd] — run without TUI for CI/automation
gsd config — re-run provider + API key setup
gsd worktree <cmd> — manage git worktrees
gsd graph <cmd> — manage knowledge graph
/gsd auto — autonomous planning and execution mode
/gsd new-project — initialize project in Pi
/gsd ship — ship completed milestone
/gsd prefs — manage preferences
/gsd extensions list|enable|disable|install — manage extensions

gsd-browser mcp — start MCP server for AI agents
gsd-browser navigate <url> — navigate to a URL
gsd-browser snapshot — scan page and assign versioned element refs
gsd-browser click <selector> — click an element

gsd-browser record-start / record-stop — record a browser session
gsd-browser session-save / session-restore — persist browser session state
gsd-browser viewer-start — start live authenticated viewer
